comment: With authorization_details the token response returns credential_identifiers, and OpenID4VCI 1.0 section 8.2 then requires credential_identifier and does not allow credential_configuration_id. The test sends a random credential_configuration_id alone and expects unknown_credential_configuration; the module answers invalid_credential_request, as section 8.3.1.2 has it for a request missing a required parameter or carrying one it may not.
